headlines.title: MO Looks Cheap Until You See the Numbers: Negative Equity, Crumbling Margins, and a Dividend About to Break
headlines.summary: Altria's 6.6% yield and 60 consecutive raises look bulletproof until you dig into what sits beneath them: a shrinking core business, a failed smoke-free pivot, and a balance sheet with liabilities that dwarf its assets.

headlines.title: Altria Group (MO) Is Back In Focus, Does It Look Fairly Valued?
headlines.summary: Why Altria Group Stock Is Back In Focus Altria Group (MO) is drawing fresh attention after a recent 1.76% share price decline left the stock lagging the broader market, just weeks before its October 29, 2026 earnings release. The recent 1.76% daily drop fits into a weaker short term trend for Altria Group, with a 30 day share price return of down 3.77% and a 90 day move of down 7.92%. This is occurring even though the year to date share price return is up 16.

headlines.title: Patron Points Names Taylor Bromley Vice President of Revenue
headlines.summary: WOODBURY, Minn., October 01, 2026--Patron Points names Taylor Bromley VP of Revenue to lead sales, bringing deep loyalty engagement experience from the manufacturer side.

headlines.title: 6 High-Yield Stocks Where the Market May Be Warning of a Dividend Cut
headlines.summary: A fat dividend yield can mean a generous payout or a stock the market has already written off, and right now six familiar names are flashing signals that suggest the difference matters more than ever.

headlines.title: Is Altria Group (MO) Reasonably Priced on Earnings Today?
headlines.summary: Altria Group has delivered strong gains over recent years, so the key issue now is whether its current share price is still aligned with what its earnings can reasonably support. With that backdrop, the valuation conversation today revolves less around momentum and more around what the profit stream behind the stock is actually worth. Altria Group has returned 112.

description: Altria Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells smokeable and oral tobacco products in the United States. It offers cigarettes primarily under the Marlboro brand; large cigars and pipe tobacco under the Black & Mild brand; moist smokeless tobacco and oral tobacco products under the Copenhagen, Skoal, Red Seal, and Husky brands; oral nicotine pouches under the on! brand; and e-vapor products under the NJOY ACE brand. The company sells its products to distributors, as well as large retail organizations, such as chain stores. Altria Group, Inc. was founded in 1822 and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.
